mapper.select: select work_id, story_summary, characters, relations, foreshadow, timeline, items, props, style_guide, threads, date_format(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time from sys_work_ledger where work_id = #{workId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_ledger (work_id, story_summary, characters, relations, foreshadow, timeline, items, props, style_guide, threads, create_time, update_time) values (#{workId}, ifnull(#{storySummary}, ''), ifnull(#{characters}, ''), ifnull(#{relations}, ''), ifnull(#{foreshadow}, ''), ifnull(#{timeline}, ''), ifnull(#{items}, ''), ifnull(#{props}, ''), ifnull(#{styleGuide}, ''), ifnull(#{threads}, ''), now(), now()) on duplicate key update story_summary = values(story_summary), characters = values(characters), relations = values(relations), foreshadow = values(foreshadow), timeline = values(timeline), items = values(items), props = coalesce(nullif(values(props), ''), props), style_guide = coalesce(nullif(values(style_guide), ''), style_guide), threads = values(threads), update_time = now()
